column1: # Perturbation families. Two independent matchers, both optional per row:
#   symbol_regex  matched against the gene symbol -- high precision for named complexes
#                 whose members share a prefix (MED*, RPL*, PSM*)
#   keywords      matched against the gene's NCBI summary + UniProt [FUNCTION] text from
#                 the gene description database; '|'-separated, case-insensitive, matched
# A gene is scored against every family (symbol hit = 3 points, each distinct keyword hit
# = 1) and assigned to its highest-scoring family; ties break toward the family listed
# FIRST, so specific complexes must precede general classes. Genes scoring zero are
# `unassigned`. Edit and re-run; nothing else changes.
